rationale.consistency: Reuses index.ReadMetadataPath/IndexFilePaths and gitindex idioms; FlagSet-per-subcommand and returned errors differ from siblings' global flag/log.Fatal but fit a subcommand tool; odd 2026 Sourcegraph header.
rationale.edge_cases: Handles root-is-repo, bare .git, .git files, duplicate names across roots, tombstones, compound shards, missing index dir, non-dir root; subcommand -h exits 1 and a root literally named list/remove is misparsed.
rationale.scope: Core ask delivered; adds up-to-date preview via new public gitindex.BranchVersions and a loop refactor of indexGitRepo, plus a sync alias and remove-by-source path: modest but purposeful creep.
rationale.readability: Small well-named functions, doc comments explain non-obvious choices (lock file left behind, shared shards); usage text hand-rolled but clear.
rationale.robustness: Non-blocking flock before planning, dry run never mkdirs or writes, errors wrapped; but NameFromConfig defaults to the new behaviour so any un-updated caller silently changes name semantics, and isUpToDate errors are swallowed under -f.
rationale.maintainability: isUpToDate duplicates IncrementalSkipIndexing logic; '-index' and 'no index directory' repeated per subcommand; inverted default on the new gitindex option is a footgun for future callers despite the comment.
